messages.subject: GGIR version 1.5-7 + Issue reports on Github + Package vignette
parts:
Dear all,

GGIR version 1.5-7
The cwa read functionality that was introduced in version 1.5-3 had a bug, this has been fixed for 1.5-7, which is on CRAN now. Windows binaries will follow soon. Note that it is important to restart R in order for this update to become active. If you are not looking at cwa data, then don't worry about this, because the rest of the package has remained unchanged.

Issue reports
From now onwards I would appreciate if you could post your issues in the issue tracker of the GGIR github repository. If you are new to github: Github accounts are free. Using github issues will make it easier for me to keep track of your issues, it will make it easier for others to help me help you, and it will reduce the traffic in this mailing list.

On a side note - Once you have a github account don't forgot to click on the star at the top of the GGIR repository, this is the software developer's equivalent of the h-index for scientists. So, if you like GGIR then please click the star :) 

I will continue using this google group / email list to inform you about new releases of GGIR and other news of general interest

Package vignette development ongoing
I have made some big expansions to the package vignette.
It seems that various users have been developing their own tutorials and standard operating procedures, hopefully the vignette can act as a useful reference point for all.

Thanks, Vincent
